results.evidence: log_event now calls _check_not_before_latest_stage_change when --stage is given. It raises EventError (exit 1) if event.occurred_at is earlier than the latest effective stage change, so nothing is written. tests/test_events_backdated_stage.py::test_backdated_stage_change_exits_1_and_writes_nothing runs the AC scenario on lead 1: the call at 09:45 with contacted_or_replied, then the walkthrough at 09:30 with --stage walkthrough. It asserts EXIT_REFUSED, that the error mentions the latest stage change with no traceback, that the activity count is unchanged, and that leads.stage is still contacted_or_replied. It then voids the call and asserts the stage returns to candidate. I ran the file with uv run --offline pytest and all 4 tests passed.
